governance.note: ercot 23 = ercot 22 (run157 keeper recipe + reliability_floor + moderated CC/coal deltas) with gas_st_netload_drag=True enabled. The net-load drag applies a per-hour min-gen floor on non-peaker ST_GAS as a monotonic function of system net-load: floor_frac = clip(0.00906 * netload_GW - 0.1376, 0, 0.34). This mirrors ERCOT RUC commitment of aging steam-gas plants during high-load periods for reliability (restart risk, voltage support). The mechanism is physics-based and forward-derivable: the coefficients come from CAMPD observed run patterns regressed on hourly net-load (docs/ercot-st-gas-netload-drag-2026-06.md). Default coefficients: slope 0.00906 CF/GW, intercept -0.1376 (zero-crossing ~15.2 GW net-load), cap 0.34. Peaker-class ST_GAS units are excluded (they run purely economically). All other settings identical to ercot 22: CC_REGULAR econ_high delta -0.10, peak delta +0.25, PRB sigmoid floor 0.76, reliability_floor=True, full run157 offer-curve/coal/storage/AS architecture. No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no adder/haircut tuned to price or volume residuals.

exceptions.reason: C2 system volume gas 2025: -6.6%. Inherited from ercot 22. The 2025 gas under-dispatch is driven by preliminary EIA-923 data (45% of ST_GAS plants not yet reporting) and the model's LP-based dispatch underestimating real-time reliability commitments beyond what the net-load drag captures. The drag closes most of the ST_GAS gap but total gas volume also includes CC/CT contributions that are separately constrained.

C3b price duration shape 2023: NRMSE 0.319. Inherited from ercot 22 / run157 keeper. The LP dual-based prices structurally compress the price distribution relative to real-market settlement prices which carry reserve/scarcity/uplift adders. Per rule #1, no fitted adder applied.
C3b price duration shape 2024: NRMSE 0.203. Same structural limitation as 2023 — LP duals vs settlement prices.

C5c storage dispatch shape 2024: r=0.000. EIA-930 battery series coverage is only 19% of hours for 2024 — insufficient for shape correlation. Model dispatches storage economically via daily cycling with vintage ramp and battery_dispatch_adder=10; the benchmark data is too sparse to score shape.

C5c storage dispatch shape 2025: r=0.000. Model storage dispatch follows arbitrage windows but shape correlation against EIA-930 monthly series fails because the model's daily cycling constraint and vintage ramp produce a flatter monthly profile than reported, which includes ancillary-service cycling the LP does not represent.
